evidence.computation: HOL literal word guard and ordered source-table lookup
assumptions: Published table rows are treated as source assertions. ASCII case folding; non-ASCII bytes cannot create a word boundary.
untrusted: JSON decoding, gate/block/ask patterns, narrative classifier, other regex patterns, source transcription.

evidence.computation: Ordered HOL source-table lookup; literal word guards checked over supplied text.
assumptions: Rows are source assertions. Pattern matching does not prove semantic entailment.
untrusted: Question construction normalization, general regex matching, narrative classification, source transcription and JSON.
